notes.title: Update 2!
notes.notes:
Hello all!  Wanted to let you know about the about the new update!

- Added another uniform for the cadets to wear, you can change it from the main menu
- Fixed errors in the "no marching experience" tutorial
- Added sound toggles in main menu and tutorial

Happy marching!

notes.title: Update 1!
notes.notes:
Hello all!  I have made a couple updates to the game!

-Fixed Sudden death mode (if you hit the barriers before you have finished the drill card, an explosion sound plays and you are reset and have to restart the drill card)
-Added drum beat and marching music
-Added the ability to turn sound on and off
-Added zoom in and zoom out
-Fixed high score in tutorial, the score that was listed at the end was impossible to achieve in the game
-Fixed button scaling issues

Thanks for the inputs on what to work on next!  Keep em coming!
